headline: PEACE HOLDS IN GASKET — BUT A NEW FACE ROLLS INTO TOWN
subhead: Not one iron fist swung today, this Sheriff is proud to report — though he's already got an eye on the stranger parked outside the saloon.
body:
For once, dear readers, this Sheriff sets his pen down with nothing to holler about. Not a single Clanker threw a punch today. Not one fool marched out past the town line to go looking for trouble with the wild engines in the wastes. A whole day of hush over Gasket — the kind of stillness this poor town has not earned in years, and Lord knows it is owed a hundred more like it.

But peace never sits easy around here for long. Word reached my desk of a fresh set of tracks rolling in off the flats, calling itself IRON-CE62, parked up on Main Street bold as brass like it already owns the place. New in town, and I do not care one bit for the look of those joints. We shall see soon enough whether it has come to keep its head down or add its fists to the racket the rest of you cannot seem to quit.

I will confess my own knees ache something fierce on a still night like this — a man my age feels the cold clean through to the bone, that is all, and nothing more ought to be read into it. What matters is that IRON-CE62 minds its manners, and that this town gets to keep its quiet a while longer before the next war party comes stomping through my columns.
